group:
uip insights looker-dashboards                         
     Read the Looker-era Insights dashboards and mint an embed URL for one      
                Use --help with nested commands for more detail.                

┌─ Usage ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ uip insights looker-dashboards [options] [command]                           │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ get-embed-url   Mint a signed, single-user Looker embed URL for one          │
│                 dashboard, by title or by id                                 │
│ help            display help for command                                     │
│ list            List the Looker-era dashboards this session can see, across  │
│                 its personal, tenant, template and organization folders      │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ -h, --help                     display help for command                      │
│ --output                       Output format (default: json)                 │
│ <table|json|yaml|plain|markd                                                 │
│ own>                                                                         │
│ --output-filter <expression>   JMESPath expression applied to the Data field │
│                                of the response envelope                      │
│ --log-level                    Log level threshold (default: info)           │
│ <debug|info|warn|error>                                                      │
│ --log-file <path>              Write logs to file instead of stderr          │
│ --profile <name>               Use a named login profile                     │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

embed:
uip insights looker-dashboards get-embed-url                  
Mint a signed, single-user Looker embed URL for one dashboard, by title or by id
                Use --help with nested commands for more detail.                

┌─ Usage ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ uip insights looker-dashboards get-embed-url [options] <dashboard>           │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ dashboard   Dashboard title, or its id from 'looker-dashboards list'         │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ --theme <theme>                Theme the embedded dashboard renders with     │
│ --localization <locale>        Locale for the embedded dashboard; Insights   │
│                                falls back to English for a locale it does    │
│                                not know                                      │
│ -h, --help                     display help for command                      │
│ --output                       Output format (default: json)                 │
│ <table|json|yaml|plain|markd                                                 │
│ own>                                                                         │
│ --output-filter <expression>   JMESPath expression applied to the Data field │
│                                of the response envelope                      │
│ --log-level                    Log level threshold (default: info)           │
│ <debug|info|warn|error>                                                      │
│ --log-file <path>              Write logs to file instead of stderr          │
│ --profile <name>               Use a named login profile                     │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
